chunks: What the Shaykh—may Allah the Exalted support him—informed me of, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, who said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام about a woman who sees in her sleep and then has discharge: is ghusl obligatory upon her? He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the legal ruling
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative answer establishing the ruling

ai.seo_question: Is ghusl obligatory for a woman if she experiences discharge after a dream?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that if a woman experiences discharge after seeing something in her sleep, ghusl is obligatory upon her. It pertains to the rulings of janabah and ritual purification in Shia fiqh.
